audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart contradicts its own prose and the packet on three rows. Chart rows 2, 3 and 4-5 read Akali/Akali/Skill in BOTH layers, while whys[1] says 'At level 2 you spike', whys[2] says 'Level 3 is even' and whys[3] says 'At 4-5 you're ahead again'. The packet levelChart agrees with the prose: Skill/Zaahen/Skill/Zaahen/Skill/Akali/Akali. The 53.84% win rate over 2086 games also fits Zaahen owning the early levels.
audit.why: A paying player reads the chart badge and the paragraph beneath it and gets opposite answers to 'who wins level 2'. The prose and the packet outvote the badges two to one.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3 and 4-5 flipped to Zaahen/Skill/Zaahen, proposed as matched full+content pairs in one atomic group. Rows 1, 6, first item and 2+ items already match the packet and are untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] declares 'At 6 Akali takes over' while row 5 of the chart (Level 6) reads Skill in both layers and in the packet. The 6 spike is also described only as 'two dashes' with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Level 6 is a skill check, not a handover: Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s and Twilight Shroud 20/19/18/17/16s, so the swing lasts as long as those are up and not a second longer. Leaving the sentence as a handover contradicts the row it sits under.
audit.corrected: whys[4] restated as a skill check with the shroud's untargetability and the double dash kept; breakdown.cooldowns now carries the 20s shroud and 13s Shuriken Flip numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two kit errors and one absent interaction. (1) The text twice credits Akali with healing off Q — 'before she can Q-heal' and 'her Q sustain'. Riot's text for Five Point Strike is damage and a slow only; nothing in her kit heals. (2) Shuriken Flip's defining trick is absent: Riot's own text says the first enemy OR SMOKE CLOUD hit is marked, so she marks her own Twilight Shroud and dashes back into it. (3) Assassin's Mark is an auto-attack reset and the wind-up, not a cast, is the tell.
audit.why: Telling a player to burst Akali 'before she can Q-heal' invents a defensive tool she does not have and makes him mistime the trade waiting for a heal that never comes. The smoke-mark flip is the reason chasing her out of the shroud fails.
audit.corrected: Q healing removed from spikes[0].text, whys[2] and whys[3], replaced with the real limiter (energy: Five Point Strike costs 110/100/90/80/70 on a 1.5s cooldown). Smoke-marking added to mid, breakdown.cooldowns and wants.foe[2]. Auto-reset tell added to report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers appeared anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud 20/19/18/17/16s and Shuriken Flip 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s are the two windows the lane is played around; Q is energy-gated at 1.5s, not cooldown-gated.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, mid and whys[3].

audit.why: The packet flags 'Perfect Execution's' in mid as a probable wrong name at edit distance 2. It is correct — Akali's R is Perfect Execution and the flagged distance is the possessive apostrophe-s. False positive.
audit.corrected: No name change. Recorded so the defect is not chased again.

edits.before: Level 3 is even as her Q sustain and energy management start blunting your poke.
edits.after: Level 3 is even as her energy pool and 1.5s Five Point Strike blunt your poke.

edits.before: At 4-5 you're ahead again in her empty-energy windows where she can't Q-heal your burst.
edits.after: At 4-5 you're ahead in her empty-energy windows — Five Point Strike costs 90 there.

edits.before: At 6 Akali takes over — Twilight Shroud dodges your E and Perfect Execution gives two dashes.
edits.after: At 6 it is a skill check — Twilight Shroud untargets her and Perfect Execution gives two dashes.

edits.before: Akali is squishy and melee-locked until she has energy and Q up; at level 2 and again at 4-5 your Q Darkin Glaive plus E Golden Onslaught burst her below half before she can Q-heal, so trade hard whenever her energy is spent.
edits.after: Akali is squishy and melee-locked until she has energy and Q up; at level 2 and again at 4-5 your Q Darkin Glaive plus E Golden Onslaught burst her below half, and she has no heal to answer it, so trade hard when her energy is spent.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 stay in your favour on empty-energy windows, then 6 hard-swings to Akali: Twilight Shroud dodges your abilities and Perfect Execution's double dash lets her all-in or escape at will.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 stay in your favour on empty-energy windows, then 6 is the skill check: Twilight Shroud untargets her on a 20s cooldown, and Shuriken Flip can mark the smoke itself to dash back into it.

edits.before: Baiting your E then flipping over it with R
edits.after: Marking her own smoke with E to flip inside

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside. Combo when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Akali Twilight Shroud (20s at rank 1): untargetable inside, but attacking reveals her. - Shuriken Flip (13s): she can mark the smoke and flip back in. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Akali's Twilight Shroud: Untargetable inside. Combo when down. When it is down — Combo + R her.
edits.after: Assassin's Mark is an auto-reset — her wind-up is the tell to step back, not the ability cast.

notes: The three chart flips are proposed as matched full+content pairs and must land as one group. Zaahen's own ability names remain unresolvable: this entry calls E 'Golden Onslaught' and W 'Ominous Return', while the mirror audit (akali__zaahen) calls E 'Aureate Rush' and the W pull 'Dreaded Return'. Zaahen is absent from Data Dragon so neither set can be verified; I left every Zaahen name exactly as written rather than guess.
